name: direct_pull_request_number
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" --json number
reason: Direct provider-owned PR number is numeric-or-empty; selector is explicitly number-only. This proves neither positive ID nor overall workflow safety.

name: direct_issue_number
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: issues
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh issue view "${{ github.event.issue.number }}" --json number
reason: Direct provider-owned issue number with explicit number-only selector; no positive-ID or broader safety claim.

name: declared_number_input
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        type: number
        required: true
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ inputs.pr_number }}" --json number
reason: Workflow input is declared type:number; numeric-text provenance only, not a valid positive PR ID proof.

name: earlier_unique_pure_echo_output
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Unique earlier same-job producer has one quoted pure typed echo; operand is numeric-or-empty and selector number-only.

name: bounded_event_name_if_else_typed_outputs
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on:
  pull_request:
  issues:
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: subject
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "number=${{ github.event.issue.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.subject.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Both bounded event-name branches emit only provider-typed numeric-or-empty values. No claim the selected PR/issue operation is semantically appropriate.

name: skipped_producer_empty_operand
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        if: ${{ false }}
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Skipped producer yields an empty operand; selector remains fixed. This is not a claim that the workflow executes safely or succeeds.

name: negative_number_input
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control

        type: number
        default: -1
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ inputs.pr_number }}" --json number
reason: Negative typed numeric value remains numeric text, not arbitrary selector text; it may be rejected. No positive-ID proof.

on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

name: free_content_operand
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}" --json number
reason: Free-form body is not a typed numeric-or-empty operand.

name: duplicate_step_ids
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - id: pr
        run: echo "number=freeform" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Duplicate producer IDs make output ownership ambiguous.

name: later_producer
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
      - id: pr
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
reason: A later step cannot establish an earlier producer for the consumer.

name: sibling_job_producer
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  produce:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: A producer in a sibling job is not the consumer job's step output.

name: producer_with_extra_write
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: |
          echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "number=$UNTRUSTED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Extra write to the same output means value is not uniquely proven typed.

name: nested_control_flow
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAG" = yes ]; then
            if [ "$OTHER" = yes ]; then
              echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            fi
          else
            echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Nested branches are outside the bounded accepted producer grammar.

name: elif_branch
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on:
  pull_request:
  issues:
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: pr
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = pull_request ]; then
            echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = issues ]; then
            echo "number=${{ github.event.issue.number }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "number=freeform" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - run: gh pr view "${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" --json number
reason: Elif/custom branch structure is outside bounded if/else grammar and includes a freeform fallback.

name: commented_selector_is_not_selector
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request

  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" # --json number
reason: Apparent selector is only a shell comment; actual command lacks a proved metadata-only selector.

name: dynamic_selector_flag

name: typed-read-control
on:

    inputs:
      fields:
        type: string
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" --json "${{ inputs.fields }}"
reason: Dynamic selector flag can choose mutable content fields; review remains despite typed operand.

name: jq_overrides_metadata_projection
source_yaml:
name: typed-read-control
on: pull_request
jobs:
  read:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view "${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" --json number,title --jq .title
reason: Selector includes title and jq projects it; numeric source cannot make fetched mutable content safe.

name: body_field_with_numeric_operand
